36K likes, 1,054 comments - sanjyotkeer on April 26, 2024: "GQ Most Influential Young Indian 2024! 💫

Honoured to be on the #GQpowerlist of the most influential young Indians. Received this award last night to recognise my work in promoting the power of regional Indian cuisine across the world and what could be a better day to receive it as it was YFL’s 8 year anniversary! ❤️

I always dreamed of showcasing Indian cuisine through my unique prospective, and 8 years back I embarked on this mission through Your Food Lab. I am grateful to have been able to share the flavours of India with kitchens around the world, reaching millions of households 🚀

Thank you to each one of you who got along on this journey with me and always a big thank you to my YFL team. 🤗🥰

This journey continues, let’s show the world the power of Indian regional cuisines! ❤️

@gqindia 

Wearing @ashay.newdelhi @ascend.rohank 
Styled by @malvika_tater Asst @vrutiiiiiiii 
Clicked by @fokuscreations 
.
.
[Indian cuisine, GQ, Most Influential Young Indian, Award]".

posts.meta_description:
105K likes, 746 comments - sanjyotkeer on May 18, 2024: "Festival de Cannes 2024 🌟

To be honest I am usually not someone who likes to put my self out there, I am relatively a very shy person, it actually took me years to even come in front of the camera when I began creating videos. I rather believe in speaking through my work as a culinary artist than how I look or be in the forefront. But I do realize that everyone does not get such opportunities to be amongst a few from your country to be invited on such global platforms and when you get one you have to put yourself out there to be spoken about, to let more people know what you do and you stand for. 

After all for me it has always been about promoting our Indian cuisine through the power of visual story telling and that journey continues. I want this to be a celebration for the Indian chef community back home that strives so hard every day. I am going to continue to let people know how incredible Indian cuisine is through my work. 

Initially walking the red carpet was a bit anxiety inducing but it felt nothing short of amazing to experience cinema in all its glory. It’s a great year for Indian Cinema which is being presented well this year at the Cannes Film Festival. 

Grateful to all of you to be a part of my journey and supporting me throughout, I wouldn’t have experienced this without you all being by my side. Gratitude ❤️

Thank you @brut.india for this opportunity ❤️

(P.S. And yes, obviously I wasn’t going to walk the carpet in my black T-shirt 😉)

Wearing custom @labelcrestelli 
Accessories @thetiehub 
Styled by @ekalakhani 
Style Team @arzoonagraik @nupur_p".

3,279 likes, 224 comments - yourfoodlab on October 10, 2026: "3 INSTANT VRAT-FRIENDLY PRESSURE COOKER RECIPES you need to try this NAVRATRI! ❤️🤌

Vrat Wale Tari Wale Aloo, Shakarkand Ki Chaat and Sama Ke Chawal Ki Kheer. Each ready in under 30 minutes, super simple to make and absolutely delicious! 🤤

And honestly, you don’t need to wait for a vrat to enjoy these. Yeh recipes kabhi bhi bana sakte ho!

Whenever I cook in this pressure cooker, so many of you ask which one it is and where to get it. Toh here it is: the Milton ProCook Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Outer Lid Pressure Cooker! I made all three recipes in it, and you should definitely check it out. ❤️

Happy Navratri to all of you! Do try these recipes and tell me your favourite.

Happy cooking! 🙏🏻".
